name: token-saver
description: Run checks, compact output, locate content, collect usage, package releases and document optional RTK integration.

interface.shortDescription: Run checks and compact their output with recoverable evidence.
interface.longDescription: Development plugin with an existing-check runner, captured-output compaction, precise repository lookup, batched GitHub status with GitLab/Linear host-tool guidance, local usage reports, deterministic package CI, authorized submission guidance, explicit issue administration, optional RTK measurement guidance and a versioned result contract. Other helpers remain planned.
defaultPrompt: Run an agreed check and retain its complete output.
Compact an existing log and retain its diagnostics.
Locate files or text in an existing repository.
Collect read-only status for known GitHub PRs or guide GitLab/Linear host-tool queries.
Submit an authorized change through Luna.
Update one explicitly named issue field.
Measure a local device usage report.
Compare optional RTK output with retained evidence.
